ns2:section.sectionText: This course serves as an introduction to data-driven and machine learning techniques in chemistry and chemical engineering. Surveyed topics will include standard regression and classification algorithms, neural network architectures, unsupervised learning, clustering, molecular featurization techniques and best practices for machine learning. The course serves as a practical introduction to these techniques in Python using existing chemical datasets. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Approved for letter and S/U grading. Prerequisites: Junior or senior standing in physical sciences or engineering, and MATH 225 or MATH 415. Basic programming experience is strongly recommended.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Chemistry or Computer Sci & Chemistry major(s).
